description: Tarpaulin suite. Runs the cargo tests under cargo-tarpaulin and measures line coverage: which source lines the tests executed. Test selection is cargo's (a changed file maps to its owning package), so a tarpaulin suite takes the same manifest a cargo suite does. After a run, the runner's coverage_summary reads the JSON report tarpaulin left in report_dir.

manifest.description: $PROJ-relative path to the Cargo.toml of the workspace to measure, for a workspace below the repo root (e.g. "engine/Cargo.toml"). Omitted, cargo measures whatever workspace the working directory is in.

ignore.description: Source files to leave out of the measurement, as tarpaulin file globs (e.g. "src/bin/*"). One glob or a list; each is passed to tarpaulin as its own --exclude-files.

report_dir.description: $PROJ-relative directory tarpaulin writes tarpaulin-report.json into. Defaults to "target/coverage/tarpaulin".

cargo_args.description: Extra arguments for the instrumented cargo build, one shell word per element (e.g. ["--features", "ml"]). Defaults to ["--no-default-features", "--locked"].
